description.text: Objectives The master program in Engineering Mechanics aims to provide solid theory and technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level researching and teaching, and solve engineering problems. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and committed. After the program, student may find jobs in high tech companies, teaching and research institutions. Duration Duration of program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Biomechanics 2. Fracture Mechnaics 3. Computational Mechanics 4. Micro-nano Mechanics 5. Structural Mechanics 6. Elastic Dynamics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 33 credits. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Engineering Mechanics at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
